The amplitude cyclic rank is zero exactly when G belongs to C[P].
Vanishing on a specified zero-dimensional cycle is equivalent to Fourier annihilation on every active primitive-amplitude channel.
The endpoint table classifies persistent polynomial moments for every phase in the q(P)<=3 Atlas.

claims.statement: For every Laurent phase with zero-pole order m and every Laurent amplitude A dz, its kth residue moment is the tau^(mk-1) coefficient of A(phi) phi prime.
A finite zero prefix proves persistent Laurent moment vanishing.
All persistent Laurent solutions are composition solutions.
